root.label: Russia presents doctored MH17 satellite images

events.label: Russia presents doctored MH17 satellite images

slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: Nearly 300 people were killed, and Russia denied its involvement, using doctored images to “prove” its case.

slots.name: flight altitude
slots.sentence:
Its final reported position was near the Russia-Ukraine border at
an altitude of 33,000 feet.

events.label: John Kerry announces U.S. intelligence detected MH17 missile launch

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence:
On July 20, Secretary of State John Kerry announced that U.S. intelligence had
detected a missile
launch
from the area where the Buks had been observed at the time MH17 was passing overhead.

events.label: MH17 flight recorders transferred to Dutch authorities

slots.name: flight recorder turnover date
slots.sentence:
MH17's "black boxes," the flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder, were
turned over to Dutch
aviation authorities on
July 23.
